sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Frog Run are simple yet challenging. The game is an endless runner, meaning that the level never ends, and the goal is to collect as much fruit as possible while avoiding obstacles. The game features a single main character, a frog, that can jump, slide, and climb walls to navigate through the level.

The controls of the game are intuitive and easy to learn, making it accessible to players of all ages. The game can be played using a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, depending on the device you're using. The controls are responsive, and the game features a smooth animation that makes it feel like you're actually playing a physical game.

One of the key features of Frog Run is its timing-based gameplay. The game requires players to time their jumps perfectly to avoid obstacles and collect fruit. The game features a variety of obstacles, including rocks, logs, and other hazards that can slow you down or even end your run. The game also features a variety of power-ups and special items that can help you navigate through the level and collect more fruit.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Frog Run are simple yet challenging, making it a great choice for players who are looking for a casual gaming experience that can be enjoyed by both children and adults.
